opening.argument: The solicitation is direct: viewers are told why people are joining BitClub Network and are urged to place Bitcoin into its mining pool rather than simply hold it. The speaker projects two to eight times more Bitcoin, then says that putting Bitcoin into mining could produce twenty five to a hundred Bitcoin in three years. A conditional price scenario is used to present a possible value of $250,000 to $1 million, while the closing appeal says, “don't miss it.” BitClub branding reinforces the invitation, and the member-only coin is presented as intended to increase in price. The named-investor material is only promotional context; it does not establish an endorsement or relationship to BitClub Network.
